The main takeaway from our work is that

the enzyme core-2 beta-1,6-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase is more active in the white blood cells of diabetic patients compared with healthy individuals, and that this may be a factor in the increased adhesion of white blood cells to blood vessel walls in diabetic patients.
